CREATE TABLE "public"."configuracion_reservas" (
  "id" int4 DEFAULT 1 NOT NULL,
  "pickupWaitMinutes" int4 DEFAULT 30 NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "version" int4 DEFAULT 1 NOT NULL,
  "weeklySchedule" jsonb,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "configuracion_reservas_positive_revision_c2490804" CHECK (version >= 1),
  CONSTRAINT "configuracion_reservas_singleton_check_7faf435e" CHECK (id = 1),
  CONSTRAINT "configuracion_reservas_wait_check_fb2a7262" CHECK ("pickupWaitMinutes" BETWEEN 1 AND 240)
)
